text:
rachel: Heads-up: ops alerted a cross-region tokenization slowdown impacting demos and the benchmark post scheduled in 30m. Need comms triage: status banner + webinar contingency. @nick @omar

nick: publish an "Investigating" banner now. short cadence: immediate, +10, +40. Keep language non-technical.

omar: ops: root cause is high disk I/O on tokenizer cache machines; we're throttling background jobs and restarting cache service. ETA ~35-70m. Recommendation: switch webinar to prerecord if ETA >30m.

status-bot: Incident created: INC-218765 (tokenizer I/O)  assigned infra-oncall.

elaine: registrant routing: send instant note offering prerecord link + option to stay for live if restored. Also tag new demo leads with "incident-tokenize" and route to shared queue.

sam: pause sponsored posts and the benchmark tweet. Also flip the webinar CTA to 'Watch the prerecord' and surface a banner saying 'Live status being monitored'.

rachel: proposed status copy: Investigating  We are aware of increased latency affecting text endpoints across regions. Engineers are working on mitigation and will update in 10 minutes. No action required at this time.

nick: add enterprise/Dedicated line: Dedicated customers expected minimal impact; reach out to CSM for issues.

omar: ops asks that we avoid implying 'outage' in public copy. Keep it 'latency' and 'mitigation'.

elaine: draft registrant note: "Quick update: We're seeing intermittent latency that may affect the live demo. You can watch the prerecord now or stay for live if it resumes. We'll update in 10 minutes with final plan."

sam: ads paused, benchmark post held. landing page updated to prerecord + 'notify me if live resumes'.

rachel: assigning: nick publish status + translations; elaine send registrant email + tag leads; sam pause socials & update landing; omar keep ops ETA updates here. I'll check at +10. Keep replies concise. :thumbsup:

nick: publishing now. spanish/fr translations pushed.

elainE: (typo)  sending registrant note now. tagging leads.

omar: update: cache service recycle in progress, queue draining. est stabilization 25-40m.

rachel: noted. if <30m we'll keep preview live for internal demo-only. if >30m switch public webinar to prerecord. prep two short follow-ups (proceed live / switch to prerecord).

nick: follow-up templates ready. will post the correct one at +10 based on ops ETA.

rachel: thanks. keep this thread tight; DM me if anything changes outside cadence.
